diagnostic_basis.development_evidence_only: On diffeq, V3 routed_timing_weight 2, 4, and 8 produced identical placements and outcomes: CPD 6.59759 ns and routed wirelength 9018 versus baseline 9103.
diagnostic_basis.identified_failure_mode: After the first acceptance, every weight repeatedly proposed the same rejected surrogate-best atomic transactions and stopped after eight closures, leaving sixteen preregistered closure slots unused.

implementation.focus_policy: Initiating units are clustered blocks on the 20 worst current routed setup paths; helper units may participate in atomic swaps/chains.
implementation.feedback_refresh: Refresh routed top-path timing and routed congestion after every accepted closure.
implementation.no_good_policy: When an atomic transaction is rejected by the native oracle, blacklist its deterministic transaction ID for the current incumbent. Select the next-ranked non-blacklisted transaction for that unit on later color visits. Clear all no-goods only after an accepted placement change.
implementation.termination: Stop at four epochs, 24 closures, exhausted candidate frontier, or a frontier round that adds no no-good and accepts no transaction.
implementation.configuration_rationale: Fix routed_timing_weight 2, the least aggressive value, because all three V3 values were exactly tied on the observed development case.
implementation.development_gate: Run the fixed configuration on all four inherited development cases. Proceed to held-out only if development CPD geometric mean improves and no case violates the wirelength cap.
implementation.held_out_policy: No further method or parameter changes after the four-case development gate; run the fixed configuration once on each inherited held-out case.

oracle.acceptance: Native legal closure, routed wirelength at most 100.5% of CPU baseline, and incumbent CPD improvement of at least 0.001 ns or exactly equal CPD with strictly lower routed wirelength.
oracle.rejection: Rollback; deterministically bisect multi-transaction batches; add a rejected atomic transaction to the current-incumbent no-good set.

prohibitions: Do not change inherited cases, inputs, hashes, seeds, channel widths, or oracle binary.
Do not tune from held-out outcomes.
Do not overwrite prior TilePlace evidence.
